description:
USmall helps you browse and shop for physical goods from international brands and retailers on the storefront USmall. Search the catalog with filters for category, color, size, audience, brand, price and discount, and open product cards with available variants, prices, stock and brand size charts when the brand supplies them. Promotional prices are shown together with their promo-code conditions.

After connecting your USmall account, you can view and update your cart, manage favorites, see your saved pickup locations and recipients, and check your order history and tracking. To get a quote, a recipient and a supported pickup location must first be set up on usmall. Quotes include delivery and any applicable promotion.

When you confirm a quote, USmall creates an unpaid order and emails you about it. Payment happens only on usmall.ru through the payment link: the app never collects card details or takes payment inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Find black men's sneakers in size 43 under 10,000 rubles
Show me the available sizes and the size chart for New Balance 530 sneakers
Find a women's down jacket in size M and add it to my cart
